d:
Raga: Devgandhar
Tala: Vilambit Ektal/ Drut Teental
Vocal: Eri E Mein Kaise Kat Kar Jaon Tum Bin Kon Sudh Le Hamari
A soulful Hindustani classical vocal rendition by Ustad Ghulam Mustafa Khan, featuring “Eri E Mein Kaise Kat Kar Jaon Tum Bin Kon Sudh Le Hamari”. The performance highlights the melodic character of the raga and the artist’s expressive voice and mastery of Hindustani classical music.
